data.title: Bedridden old woman carried 9km through rain to the bank
data.description: KANCHANABURI - Neighbours carried a bedridden 90-year-old woman on a stretcher for about 9 kilometres through heavy rain so she could rectify a problem with her ATM card at a bank branch in Sangkhla Buri district.

data.title: Use of banned ‘red meat’ chemicals in cattle uncovered
data.description: Thai authorities have arrested a chemical supplier after finding salbutamol, a beta agonist used illegally as a “red meat” enhancer, in nearly 1,000 cattle in an eight-month investigation spanning five provinces.

data.title: CJ MORE launches “CJ STAR: Local Goodness, Starred” project
data.description: CJ MORE has launched “CJ STAR: Local Goodness, Starred,” a project designed to create opportunities for quality products from communities across Thailand and help small entrepreneurs develop their capabilities, expand distribution channels and reach a wider consumer base.

data.title: Neramit Amphawa Amazing Thailand Food Festival in Samut Songkhram ‘city of three waters’
data.description: Event creates night-time journey through food, waterways, light, heritage and community life across Amphawa from Sept 11–20

data.title: Cambodia ‘playing the victim’ in sea dispute, says Thailand
data.description: Thailand accused Cambodia on Tuesday of playing the victim in their dispute over maritime resources, as the Southeast Asian neighbours took their feud to international mediators a year after deadly clashes over their land border.

data.title: Building Organizations That Transform Faster Than Technology Changes
data.description: Only a few years ago, the breakthrough in generative AI allowed us for the first time to ask a machine a question and receive a remarkably human-like answer. OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1 represent the latest frontiers in what machines can now do across coding, computer use, and scientific work. But the real problem for business leaders is the speed at which the boundary of what machines can do keeps moving.

data.title: Bangkok temples celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi from September 14-25
data.description: Three Bangkok temples mark Ganesh Chaturthi from September 14-25, with worship ceremonies and farewell rituals in Kanchanaburi and Chonburi.

data.title: AC condensation, undersized screws caused parliament ceiling collapse
data.description: Water dripping from air conditioning ducts and undersized screws used in ceiling panels caused the ceiling of the cafeteria at the parliament complex in Bangkok to collapse on Sunday, an inspection has found.

data.title: Bangkok Art Biennale 2026 Opens Creative Space with BAB TALK & Workshop
data.description: The Bangkok Art Biennale Foundation recently organised “BAB TALK & Workshop”, an engaging programme inviting participants to explore contemporary art and gain insight into the creative process with Shin Min, a South Korean artist participating in the Bangkok Art Biennale 2026 (BAB 2026). Held under the theme “Angels and Mara”, the event took place at BAB Café, Bangkok Art and Culture Centre (BACC).

data.title: Beijing imposes total ban on drones after deadly crash
data.description: Beijing has introduced stricter drone regulations, banning all uncrewed flights as well as the possession and storage of existing devices, while detailing disposal methods for the first time in an effort to strengthen security in the capital.

data.title: ONE Championship: Freddie Haggerty offers Johan Ghazali flyweight fight – after ‘a couple wins’
data.description: Freddie Haggerty says he is willing to move up to flyweight to fight Johan Ghazali in ONE Championship – but wants him to pick up “a couple wins” before entertaining the match-up.

data.title: Remains exhumed, moved from unlicensed Jewish cemetery
data.description: CHACHOENGSAO - Four bodies were exhumed at an unlicensed Jewish cemetery in Bang Khla district and moved to a licensed cemetery in adjoining Chon Buri province on Tuesday morning.

data.title: 'Hands off Koh Kut': Thailand stands firm at UN maritme talks
data.description: Thailand has made its position clear during maritime border talks with Cambodia under the UN law of the sea - Koh Kut is not part of the reconciliation process.

data.title: Chinese procurer fleeing prison in China arrested in Thailand
data.description: A 32-year-old Chinese woman allegedly fleeing a prison term in China for procuring women for prostitution has been arrested on a roadside near Suvarnabhumi airport after earlier entering Thailand illegally.

data.title: Health agency reports 87,770 flu cases in August, with diarrhoea and Covid ranking next
data.description: Rabies led the case fatality ranking with one case and one death, while Thai officials urged stronger precautions against rising Covid infections

data.title: US military confirms Iran war has led to munitions shortfall
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The United States is facing a shortfall in ammunition as a result of its war against Iran, the Defense Department's inspector general confirmed Monday, contrasting with President Donald Trump's assertions of full stocks.

data.title: Berlin's run-down public spaces at heart of election campaign
data.description: BERLIN — Politicians campaigning for Sunday's Berlin state election have painted an unflattering picture of the German capital, vowing to clear garbage-strewn streets and promising "syringe-free playgrounds".

data.title: ONE Championship: Xavier Gonzalez hints at rematch as Thway Lin Htet backs judges
data.description: Xavier Gonzalez has fuelled talk of an immediate rematch with Thway Lin Htet in ONE Championship after telling the Bangkok Post “100” when asked if his newly signed next fight would reunite the pair.

data.title: Chinese procuror fleeing prison in China arrested in Thailand
data.description: A 32-year-old Chinese woman allegedly fleeing a prison term in China for procuring women for prostitution has been arrested on a roadside near Suvarnabhumi airport after earlier entering Thailand illegally.

data.title: The Speak Easy
data.description: A passionate project, Bees Bar by Narisawa is a sustainable cocktail bar created by Japanese chef Yoshihiro Narisawa.
